wiki.description: England is a country that is part of the United Kingdom. It shares land borders with Wales to its west and Scotland to its north. The Irish Sea lies northwest of England and the Celtic Sea to the southwest. England is separated from continental Europe by the North Sea to the east and the English Channel to the south. England comprises most of the central and southern part of the island of Great Britain, which lies in the North Atlantic.

wiki.description: Scotland is a country that is part of the United Kingdom. The country consists of more than 790 islands, including the Northern Isles and the Hebrides. Scotland's capital is Edinburgh, and its largest city is Glasgow.

wiki.description: Northern Ireland is a part of the United Kingdom, situated in the northeast of the island of Ireland. It shares a border to the south and west with the Republic of Ireland. In 2021, its population was 1,903,100.

Anguilla.description: Anguilla is a British Overseas Territory in the Caribbean, known for its flat limestone landform, coral reefs, and white-sand beaches.

Bermuda.description: Bermuda is a self-governing British Overseas Territory in the North Atlantic Ocean, famous for pink-sand beaches and historic maritime history.

British Virgin Islands.description: The British Virgin Islands comprise over 50 islands in the Caribbean, renowned for sailing, coral reefs, and dramatic volcanic landscapes.

Cayman Islands.description: The Cayman Islands consist of 3 islands in the western Caribbean Sea, famous for coral reefs, deep-sea diving, and Seven Mile Beach.

Falkland Islands.description: The Falkland Islands are a remote South Atlantic archipelago featuring rugged terrain, cliff-lined coasts, and rich penguin colony wildlife.

Montserrat.description: Montserrat is a mountainous Caribbean island in the Lesser Antilles, known as the Emerald Isle of the Caribbean with dramatic volcanic geography.

Turks and Caicos Islands.description: The Turks and Caicos Islands are a tropical archipelago of 40 low-lying coral islands southeast of Mayaguana in the Bahamas.

Gibraltar.description: Gibraltar is a British Overseas Territory located at the southern tip of the Iberian Peninsula dominated by the iconic Rock of Gibraltar.

Guernsey.description: Guernsey is a Channel Island in the English Channel off the coast of Normandy, known for beach resorts, coastal castles, and scenery.

Isle of Man.description: The Isle of Man is a self-governing Crown Dependency in the Irish Sea between Great Britain and Ireland, known for rugged coastlines and sports culture.

Jersey.description: Jersey is the largest of the Channel Islands between England and France, known for cliffside walking trails, tidal bays, and historic castles.

Cook Islands.description: The Cook Islands are 15 islands scattered over a vast area in the South Pacific, famed for coral reefs, lagoons, and volcanic peaks.

Niue.description: Niue is a small Pacific island nation known as the Rock of Polynesia, famous for coral limestone cliffs and clear ocean waters.

Norfolk Island.description: Norfolk Island is a tiny island in the Pacific Ocean defined by pine trees, dramatic coastal jagged cliffs, and rich history.
